prompt: Why does longest_consecutive avoid starting a run at every value?

options.explanation: The implementation builds and probes a set; it never sorts it.

options.text: It starts only where the predecessor is absent
options.explanation: Correct: only a true run start begins the forward traversal.

options.text: It assumes input order is consecutive
options.explanation: A set has no consecutive input-order guarantee; membership identifies neighbouring numeric values.
Negative consecutive integers work as well; the algorithm does not filter them out.

workedExample: A value with a predecessor belongs to a run that will be traversed from its true start. Skipping it avoids rescanning suffixes of that run. Each distinct value is reached a constant number of times under the expected constant-time set-operation assumption.
